subject.title: fix(discord): ignore reply pings in bot mention-only mode

question: Should `channels.discord.allowBots: "mentions"` intentionally stop treating an implicit reply-to-bot reference as a mention when the sender is another bot?
rationale: The requested change resolves reply-loop noise, but it narrows a documented mention-detection path and can break existing bot-to-bot workflows that relied on native Discord reply references.

options.title: Adopt the bot-sender exception
options.body: Keep reply metadata excluded for bot senders, preserve transcript pattern matching, and document that cross-bot handoffs require an inline or configured mention.

options.title: Preserve reply semantics
options.body: Retain implicit reply-to-bot admission for bot senders and rely on loop protection or a separately designed opt-in strict mode.

recommendation.title: Adopt the bot-sender exception
recommendation.body: Keep reply metadata excluded for bot senders, preserve transcript pattern matching, and document that cross-bot handoffs require an inline or configured mention.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a compatibility and channel-policy decision rather than a purely mechanical correction.
